requirement: The system shall list routers by project and create, update, and delete router deployments in Kubernetes. Router user containers shall use a configurable port, defaulting to 8080.

The system shall allow users to create, retrieve, update, and delete ensemblers within a specified project. It shall reject deletion of an ensembler that is in use and distinguish successful deletion from a missing ensembler or a deletion failure.
The system shall run user-defined ensemblers as web services for use by Turing routers. Locally built PyFuncEnsembler Docker images shall use model artifacts obtained from the MLflow model registry.

When authorization is enabled, the system shall reject unauthorized resource-management requests. When request validation is enabled, it shall reject requests that do not conform to the documented OpenAPI 3.0.3 specification.
The router shall support Jaeger request tracing, with trace generation controlled by tracing enablement and sampling configuration.

Router configuration shall support HTTP_JSON and UPI_V1 protocols and restrict traffic-rule field sources to those permitted by the selected protocol. Timeout settings shall accept non-negative whole-number values expressed in milliseconds, seconds, minutes, or hours.
